description: a young man healer with short black hair, a long white robe with a brown belt, an olive-yellow hooded mantle, brown shoes, a tall wooden shepherd staff with small white flowers held upright in his right hand at arm's length in front of him, its curled top high above his head and far from his face, nothing near his mouth, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
